markdown_content: ## Garment Display Settings and Default File Management in CLO 2025.1 This document explains how to save and manage garment display settings and default project files in CLO 2025.1. It covers toggling display preferences, saving garment files with customized settings, and configuring default project files to streamline workflow and ensure consistent views when opening new projects. --- ### Saving Garment Display Settings within Project and Garment Files CLO 2025.1 allows users to save display settings such as quality render mode, avatar visibility, and toggle menus directly within project files (.zfab) and garment files. This ensures that when you reopen a garment or project file, your preferred display environment loads automatically. **Procedure:** 1. Adjust your display settings in the 3D window: - Choose render quality (e.g., Quality Render). - Toggle avatar visibility on or off. - Configure other display elements as needed (e.g., baselines, 3D pen). 2. Save the garment with these settings: - Go to `File` > `Save As` > `Garment`. - Save the garment file to your desired location. 3. Open the saved garment file: - Use `File` > `Open` > `Garment`. - The garment will load with all the saved display settings intact. This feature is especially useful for maintaining consistent visualization across different sessions and sharing garments with preset display configurations. --- ### Setting Up a Default Project File with Customized Display Preferences You can create a default project file with specific display settings to load automatically every time you start CLO. This saves time and ensures a consistent working environment across projects. **Steps to create and set a default project file:** 1. **Create a new project:** - Go to `File` > `New Project`. 2. **Customize your workspace and display settings:** - Adjust render quality (e.g., Quality Render). - Toggle off/on baseline visibility or 3D pen display. - Choose avatar preferences (e.g., specific avatar model, visibility). - Add pattern pieces or other elements as needed (e.g., place a small pattern piece on the ground to customize workspace view). 3. **Save the project as your default:** - Go to `File` > `Save As Project`. - Name the file (e.g., `Default Display`). 4. **Set the saved project as the default in user settings:** - Navigate to `Settings` > `User Settings` > `Default Files` > `Project File`. - Open and select your saved default project file. - Confirm and close the settings window. 5. **Restart CLO:** - When reopening CLO, your default project file will load automatically with all your customized display settings and workspace arrangements. This setup ensures every new project starts with your preferred environment, including avatar choice, toggle menu configurations, and display settings such as render quality and visibility options. --- ### Using Display Settings Override When Opening Garment Files When opening garment files, you can override the garment's saved display settings with your current project’s display preferences. - When opening a garment file, enable the option to **override display settings**. - This allows the garment to load but display according to the project’s current settings rather than the garment’s saved settings. - Useful if you want to maintain consistent display preferences across multiple garments regardless of their individual saved settings. --- ### Summary of Key Features - **Display settings saved within project (.zfab) and garment files:** Enables consistent visualization. - **Default project file configuration:** Allows automatic loading of preferred workspace and display settings each time CLO opens. - **Override display settings on garment load:** Ensures display preferences are maintained across garments. - **Customization options include:** Render quality (Quality Render), avatar visibility and selection, toggling baselines and 3D pen visibility, and workspace setup. These features improve workflow efficiency, consistency, and ease of use when managing garment and project files in CLO 2025.1.
